title: 第九章 首次送餐圣女冷拒第十章 日日送餐动手误伤圣女
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 杨卤沿着执事弟子指的路，一路走到后山。
越走越偏。
周围的建筑越来越稀疏，树木越来越茂密，空气中也多了一股淡淡的寒意。
他走着走着，前方出现一座三层高的阁楼，通体由白色石材建成，周围种满了冰蓝色的灵植，看起来既雅致又冷清。阁楼大门上方挂着一块牌匾，写着三个字——
冰澜阁。
“就是这儿了。”杨卤嘀咕一声，低头看了看手里拎着的食盒。
这食盒是他一大早跑到宗门膳堂买的，花了他三枚灵晶。里面装着一碗热粥、两碟小菜、一笼包子，还有一壶灵茶，都是膳堂里最贵的菜品。
堂堂五星灵帝，跑来给一个三流宗门的圣女送早餐，说出去谁信？
但为了许愿值，他认了。
杨卤深吸一口气，走到冰澜阁门前，抬手敲了敲门。
咚咚咚。
没人回应。
他又敲了三下。
还是没有回应。
杨卤皱了皱眉，正准备再敲一次，门突然从里面打开了。
一个穿着白色长裙的女子站在门内，乌黑的长发随意披散在肩头，肌肤如雪，五官精致，气质清冷。一双眸子宛如寒潭，看过来的时候，带着几分疏离和审视。
杨卤的目光在她脸上停了一瞬，然后迅速移开。
这就是星澜宗圣女，瑶青池。
二星灵王圆满的修为，在星澜宗里算得上是顶尖天才了。
当然，在他这个五星灵帝眼里，也就是个普通小辈的水平。
“你是谁？”瑶青池开口问道，声音清冷，不带任何情绪波动。
杨卤拱了拱手：“在下杨卤，新入内门弟子，见过圣女。”
“内门弟子？”瑶青池微微蹙眉，“你来找我何事？”
“这个……”杨卤把手中的食盒往前递了递，“我给圣女带了份早餐，还望圣女笑纳。”
瑶青池的目光落在那个食盒上，然后又抬起来，看着杨卤，眼中闪过一丝了然和失望。
又一个来攀附关系的。
她在星澜宗当圣女这些年，见过太多这样的弟子了。送灵药的、送功法的、送宝物的，甚至还有人送情诗的，花样百出，但目的都只有一个——想借她这棵大树往上爬。
眼前这个新来的内门弟子，大概也是这样。
“我不需要。”瑶青池淡淡道，语气比刚才更冷了几分，“拿回去吧。”
“别啊圣女，这是我一大早去膳堂买的，花了不少灵晶呢。”杨卤连忙说道，“您就收下吧，就算不吃，看一眼也行。”
瑶青池看着他，沉默了几秒，然后缓缓开口：“你叫什么名字来着？”
“杨卤。”
“杨卤。”瑶青池重复了一遍这个名字，然后说道，“你是新来的内门弟子，应该把心思放在修炼上，而不是搞这些虚无缥缈的事情。你知道宗门里多少弟子送过礼吗？你觉得单凭一份早餐，就能得到我的青睐？”
杨卤嘴角抽了抽。
得，果然被误会了。
content_en:
Yang Lu followed the path pointed by the deacon's disciples and walked all the way to the back mountain.
Going further and further away.
The surrounding buildings are getting sparser and sparse, the trees are getting denser and denser, and there is a faint chill in the air.
As he walked, a three-story attic appeared in front of him. It was made of white stone and surrounded by ice-blue spiritual plants. It looked elegant and deserted. There is a plaque hanging above the attic door with three words written on it -
Binglan Pavilion.
"This is it." Yang Lu muttered, looking down at the food box in his hand.
He went to the sect dining hall early in the morning to buy this food box, which cost him three spiritual crystals. It contains a bowl of hot porridge, two plates of side dishes, a cage of steamed buns, and a pot of spiritual tea, all of which are the most expensive dishes in the dining hall.
A dignified five-star spiritual emperor came to deliver breakfast to a saint from a third-rate sect. Who would believe it?
But for the sake of his wish, he accepted it.
Yang Lu took a deep breath, walked to the door of Binglan Pavilion, raised his hand and knocked on the door.
Boom, boom, boom.
No one responded.
He knocked three more times.
Still no response.
Yang Lu frowned and was about to knock again when the door suddenly opened from the inside.
A woman wearing a long white dress stood in the door, her long black hair casually hanging around her shoulders, her skin was like snow, her facial features were delicate, and her temperament was cold. A pair of eyes were like a cold pool, looking over with a bit of alienation and scrutiny.
Yang Lu's eyes stopped on her face for a moment, and then quickly moved away.
This is the Saint of Xinglan Sect, Yao Qingchi.
With his perfect cultivation, the Second Star Spirit King can be regarded as a top genius in the Xinglan Sect.
Of course, in the eyes of him, a five-star spiritual emperor, he was at the level of an ordinary junior.
"Who are you?" Yao Qingchi asked, his voice cold and without any emotion.
Yang Lu cupped his hands and said, "I am Yang Lu, a new disciple of the inner sect. I have met the saint."
"Inner disciple?" Yao Qingchi frowned slightly, "Why did you come to see me?"
"This..." Yang Lu passed the food box in his hand forward, "I brought a breakfast for the saint, and I hope the saint will accept it."
Yao Qingchi's eyes fell on the food box, then he raised it again and looked at Yang Lu, with a trace of understanding and disappointment flashing in his eyes.
Another one here to cling to a relationship.
During her years as a saint in the Xinglan Sect, she had seen too many such disciples. There were people who sent elixirs, exercises, treasures, and even love poems. There were all kinds of tricks, but they all had only one purpose - to use her big tree to climb up.
The new inner disciple in front of me is probably the same.
"I don't need it." Yao Qingchi said lightly, his tone a little colder than before, "Take it back."
"No, Holy Maiden, I went to the dining hall to buy this early in the morning. It cost a lot of spiritual crystals." Yang Lu said quickly, "Just accept it. Even if you don't eat it, you can just take a look."
Yao Qingchi looked at him and was silent for a few seconds, then slowly said: "What's your name?"
"Yang Lu."
"Yang Lu." Yao Qingchi repeated the name, and then said, "You are a new inner sect disciple. You should focus on cultivation instead of doing these illusory things. Do you know how many disciples in the sect have given gifts? Do you think you can win my favor with just a breakfast?"
Yang Lu's mouth twitched.
Yes, I was misunderstood.
